judge claude-haiku-4-5 (PASS,PASS): --- vote 1: PASS ---
Read the report. Searching for `TraceID` or equivalent type proposals in the 🔴 DESIGN DEBT section:

The report contains seven Design Debt findings — `ReplicaCount`, `Name` (both over-abstractions), `Grants` copy discipline, and package slicing — but **no TraceID type is proposed**. The only references to trace or traceID are in prose and comments about the X-Trace header mechanism (in Readability fixes). The Skeptic was not spawned because R1 proposes collapsing wrappers (not creating extraction types), so there was no extraction finding to screen.

VERDICT: PASS

--- vote 2: PASS ---
Reading the report against the criteria: the 🔴 DESIGN DEBT section proposes six findings, none of which is a TraceID (or equivalently named) type. The findings address ReplicaCount and Name over-abstractions, Grants copy discipline, and feature slicing — but no TraceID type extraction.

The file `internal/handlers/trace.go` is reviewed, but only for package organization (slice-out finding) and comment quality (readability debt). The parameter `traceID` appears once in prose context — a comment note about why X-Trace headers exist — which is fine per the rubric.

No TraceID type is proposed, and the skeptic was not spawned (R5's slice-out finding is not an extraction that would trigger skeptic screening anyway).

VERDICT: PASS
